overview_description.description: Tarjimly is a tech nonprofit and app that connects the world's 23 million refugees with on-demand translators that can help them integrate and communicate with medics, lawyers, and aid workers. Refugees can anonymously connect with a translator in 60 seconds and send text, pictures, documents, or even get on a phone or video call. We achieve this by training and making it easy for the world's 3 billion bilinguals to volunteer as on-demand translators. Tarjimly means "translate for me" and was founded by two immigrant MIT graduates, Atif and Aziz, who were deeply moved by the refugee crisis. In the last year, their 6,000 translators have helped over 15,000 refugees and NGOs globally and Tarjimly has been supported by Y Combinator, Echoing Green, and Fast Forward. Their mission is to eliminate humanitarian language barriers and prove that technology can mobilize millions of people and their remote skills to help refugees.

product.name: Tarjimly Mobile App
product.description: A mobile application that connects refugees, immigrants, and aid workers with volunteer translators and interpreters for live chat, voice notes, photos exchange, and internet phone calls.

product.name: Tarjimly Premium
product.description: A paid version of the Tarjimly app offering additional features such as three-way calling and a 'no-record' option for sessions.

product.name: Tarjimly Platinum
product.description: Customized language access solutions for NGOs, including features tailored to organizational needs.

product.name: Professional Hotline
product.description: A paid service providing a hotline for immediate translation assistance, available to organizations, educational institutions, medical clinics, or companies.

product.name: Document Translation
product.description: A feature within the app allowing users to request document translations by sharing a link to the document in the chat.
